description: Discrete Deformation Calculus records finite obstruction-handling traces using eight operation letters. On declared finite rational cochain complexes, the companion computes a weighted ℓ¹ quotient distance Φ₁ and closure defect Γ₂, with independently checked primal and dual witnesses for the quotient distance. Core Lean proves tape laws for a finite-control transition system over unbounded abstract data: composition, absorption, no decrease without descent or lift, and conditional CREDIT laws. Witness-presence booleans and detector adequacy are assumptions of that model. Optional carrier-bound Python replay recomputes diagnostics and verifies quotient preservation; it does not authenticate licences. Hash-chain consistency is distinguished from history integrity against an independently retained checkpoint. Written Hodge and finite-optimization proofs, exact examples, two executable notebooks, tests and a standalone deposit verifier accompany the manuscript. No deployed-runtime equivalence or general detector-adequacy theorem is claimed.
